instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Wealth management advisory serving 400+ high-net-worth families with holistic financial planning, tax optimization, and estate structuring. Blending in-person advisory with a client portal for portfolio tracking. Seeking to enhance client reporting with interactive scenario modeling tools.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine that has become our fastest-growing SKU.
answers.strategicGoals: Our core business is stable and cash-generative, but we see limited growth potential within our current market. We are actively exploring adjacent business models—potentially a marketplace, a subscription-based service layer, or a data monetization play built on the proprietary data we already collect. We are willing to incubate 2-3 experimental business lines with seed funding to test viability.
answers.additionalContext: Helix Analytics possesses unique proprietary data sets spanning complex tax structures and philanthropic giving patterns, offering a distinct competitive moat in the advisory space.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

opportunities.title: Advanced Hyper-Personalized Tax Modeling Engine (AI/ML)
opportunities.rationale: Given the existing AI recommendation engine success, scaling this to include complex cross-border tax optimization models would significantly enhance client value and capture a high-margin niche.

first_actions: Form a dedicated squad focused solely on Tax Modeling integration.
Run a 6-month pilot with the top 50 clients to validate model accuracy.
resources_needed: Subscription license for advanced financial modeling software
execution_plan.success_metric: 15% increase in average asset under management (AUM) per client.
milestones: Q3: Model MVP deployment to internal testing group.
Q4: Beta launch and integration into standard advisory workflow.

opportunities.title: FinTech Advisory Marketplace (Platform Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging proprietary data to create a subscription-based marketplace connecting high-net-worth clients with specialized, verified third-party vendors for niche services like philanthropic structuring or complex trust management. This directly addresses the strategic goal of diversification.

first_actions: Conduct market validation interviews with potential vendor partners.
Define core data standards required to vet and onboard 5 initial vendors.
resources_needed: Legal counsel for marketplace liability framework
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure contracts with 10 vetted third-party service providers within 6 months.
milestones: Q3: Platform MVP launch (beta) and successful onboarding of first vendors.
Q4: Achieve $50k in transaction volume through marketplace listings.

opportunities.title: Automated Regulatory Compliance Dashboard
opportunities.rationale: Given the medium regulatory environment, automating compliance reporting and documentation across all client portfolios would reduce operational risk and increase advisory efficiency.

first_actions: Audit current compliance workflow gaps with legal counsel.
Select and implement a solution for real-time data validation.
resources_needed: Integration costs with existing client portal infrastructure
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual compliance reporting hours by 40%.
milestones: Q3: Implementation of core regulatory data aggregation module.
Q4: Full rollout and integration into quarterly reporting cycle.

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated task force for the Marketplace diversification strategy.
Finalize and launch the pilot program for the Tax Modeling Engine MVP.
Conduct a deep cultural assessment focusing on overcoming internal inertia and promoting radical ideas.

key_weaknesses: Cultural resistance to high-risk, radical innovation necessary for market diversification.
Fragmented digital maturity across teams leading to inconsistent operational standards and scalability challenges.
High dependence on existing revenue streams which may discourage the aggressive testing required for new business models.
